jobs.title: Power & Gas Trader
jobs.description:
Mission

Support the optimization and trading of Alpiq's thermal asset portfolio across European short-term energy markets. The role combines market analysis, risk taking, and execution of trading strategies to maximize portfolio value while operating within defined risk limits.

Your main responsibilities

• Analyze fundamental drivers of European power markets, including supply/demand balances, weather, fuel and carbon prices, renewable generation, outages, and cross-border flows.

• Identify and execute trading opportunities across short-term European power and gas markets.

• Take and actively manage proprietary risk positions within assigned limits.

• Support the optimization and value creation of physical generation assets and portfolios.

• Develop market views and translate them into actionable trading strategies.

• Monitor and assess optionality embedded in assets and market structures.

• Contribute to the development of AI-enabled trading tools, data-driven decision processes, and systematic trading capabilities.

Your profile

• Minimum 5 years of experience trading short-term European power and gas markets

• Strong understanding of European power market fundamentals and the ability to convert market views into trading decisions.

• Proven risk-taking mindset combined with disciplined risk management.

• Good understanding of financial options, derivatives, and optionality concepts.

• Experience trading or optimizing physical assets is a strong advantage.

• Strong analytical and quantitative skills.
What Success Looks Like

• Consistently generates and executes profitable trading ideas based on fundamental market analysis.

• Demonstrates sound judgment in taking and managing risk.

• Develops a strong understanding of asset-backed trading and portfolio optionality.

• Becomes a trusted contributor to the Asset Trading desk's performance and decision-making.

Missione

Sostenere l'ottimizzazione e il trading del portafoglio di asset termici di Alpiq nei mercati europei dell'energia a breve termine. Il ruolo combina l'analisi di mercato, l'assunzione di rischi e l'esecuzione di strategie di trading per massimizzare il valore del portafoglio, operando entro limiti di rischio definiti.

Le tue principali responsabilità

• Analizzare i driver fondamentali dei mercati europei del potere, compresi i bilanci di approvvigionamento/demand, i prezzi meteo, del combustibile e del carbonio, la generazione rinnovabile, le interruzioni e i flussi transfrontalieri.

• Identificare ed eseguire le opportunità di trading sui mercati europei di energia e di gas a breve termine.

• Prendere e gestire attivamente le posizioni di rischio proprietarie entro limiti assegnati.

• Sostenere l'ottimizzazione e la creazione di valore di beni e portafogli di generazione fisica.

• Sviluppare le opinioni di mercato e tradurle in strategie di trading attuabili.

• Monitorare e valutare l'opzionalità incorporata in beni e strutture di mercato.

• Contribuire allo sviluppo di strumenti di trading abilitati all'intelligenza artificiale, processi decisionali basati sui dati e capacità di trading sistematiche.

Il tuo profilo

• Minimo 5 anni di esperienza di trading a breve termine

• Forte comprensione dei fondamentali del mercato europeo del potere e la capacità di convertire le opinioni di mercato nelle decisioni di trading.

• Prove mindset assunzione di rischio combinato con la gestione del rischio disciplinato.

• Buona comprensione delle opzioni finanziarie, dei concetti derivati e dell'opzionalità.

• Il trading di esperienze o l'ottimizzazione dei beni fisici è un forte vantaggio.

• Forte capacità analitiche e quantitative.
Che successo sembra

• Coerentemente genera ed esegue idee di trading redditizie basate sull'analisi di mercato fondamentale.

• Dimostra il giudizio positivo nell'assunzione e nella gestione del rischio.

• Sviluppa una forte comprensione di asset-backed trading e portafoglio opzionale.

• Diventa un collaboratore affidabile per le prestazioni e il processo decisionale del banco Asset Trading.

Mission

Unterstützung der Optimierung und des Handels mit Alpiqs thermischem Anlageportfolio in den europäischen kurzfristigen Energiemärkten. Die Rolle kombiniert Marktanalyse, Risikobereitschaft und Ausführung von Handelsstrategien, um den Portfoliowert zu maximieren und gleichzeitig innerhalb definierter Risikogrenzen zu operieren.

Ihre Hauptaufgaben

• Analysieren Sie grundlegende Treiber der europäischen Strommärkte, einschließlich Angebots-/Nachfragebilanzen, Wetter, Kraftstoff- und CO2-Preise, Stromerzeugung aus erneuerbaren Energiequellen, Ausfälle und grenzüberschreitende Stromflüsse.

• Identifizieren und Ausführen von Handelsmöglichkeiten auf den kurzfristigen europäischen Strom- und Gasmärkten.

• Übernahme und aktives Management proprietärer Risikopositionen innerhalb der zugewiesenen Grenzen.

• Unterstützung bei der Optimierung und Wertschöpfung von physischen Erzeugungsanlagen und Portfolios.

• Entwickeln Sie Marktansichten und übersetzen Sie sie in umsetzbare Handelsstrategien.

• Überwachung und Bewertung der in Vermögenswerte und Marktstrukturen eingebetteten Optionalität.

• Tragen Sie zur Entwicklung von KI-fähigen Handelsinstrumenten, datengesteuerten Entscheidungsprozessen und systematischen Handelsfunktionen bei.

Dein Profil

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Handel mit kurzfristigen europäischen Strom- und Gasmärkten

• Starkes Verständnis der Grundlagen des europäischen Strommarktes und die Fähigkeit, Marktansichten in Handelsentscheidungen umzuwandeln.

• Bewährte Risikobereitschaft kombiniert mit diszipliniertem Risikomanagement.

• Gutes Verständnis von Finanzoptionen, Derivaten und Optionalitätskonzepten.

• Erfahrung mit dem Handel oder der Optimierung von physischen Vermögenswerten ist ein großer Vorteil.

• Starke analytische und quantitative Fähigkeiten.
Wie Erfolg aussieht

• Konsequent generiert und führt profitable Handelsideen basierend auf fundamentalen Marktanalysen aus.

• Demonstriert fundiertes Urteilsvermögen bei der Übernahme und Verwaltung von Risiken.

• Entwickelt ein starkes Verständnis von Asset-Backed Trading und Portfolio-Optionalität.

• Wird ein vertrauenswürdiger Beitrag zur Leistung und Entscheidungsfindung des Asset Trading Desk.

• Surveiller et évaluer le caractère facultatif des actifs et des structures du marché.

• Contribuer à la mise au point d'outils de négociation axés sur l'IA, de processus décisionnels axés sur les données et de capacités de négociation systématiques.

Votre profil

• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience sur le marché européen de l'électricité et du gaz à court terme

• Une bonne compréhension des fondamentaux du marché européen de l'électricité et de la capacité de convertir les vues du marché en décisions commerciales.

• Une prise de risque éprouvée combinée à une gestion du risque disciplinée.

• Bonne compréhension des options financières, des produits dérivés et des concepts d'optionnalité.

• Expérience de négociation ou d'optimisation des actifs physiques est un avantage important.

• Fortes compétences analytiques et quantitatives.
À quoi ressemble le succès

• Génére et exécute de manière cohérente des idées commerciales rentables fondées sur une analyse de marché fondamentale.

• Démontre un bon jugement dans la prise et la gestion des risques.

• Élabore une bonne compréhension de l'option de négociation et de portefeuille adossés à des actifs.

• Devient un contributeur fiable au rendement et à la prise de décisions du bureau de négociation d'actifs.

jobs.title: Senior Gas Prop Trader

jobs.description:
ICTs

OT Network & System Engineer

•

Lausanne, CH - 100% | Full time

About the Role

Role type: Permanent | Location: Switzerland | Model: On-Site | Level of travels: 10 %

Send us your application

Are you looking to make an impact in the energy sector? Become part of Alpiq - your energy matters!

Apply now

Our Company

Alpiq is one of Switzerland’s leading electricity producers and a key energy services provider across Europe. Headquartered in Lausanne and powered by a strong portfolio of hydropower, nuclear, and renewable energy sources, we’re all about impact, for the climate, for people, and for the security of supply.

More than 1,300 colleagues from nearly 60 nationalities bring their energy to a shared purpose: Together for a better climate and an improved security of supply.

We work in a values-driven culture shaped by trust, curiosity, and respect. Our 4 company values have been co-created with our employees and are embedded in everything we do as a company:

“We are ALP1Q “- reflects our team spirit

“We learn and grow together” - we have courage

“We share the steering wheel” - we take ownership

“We focus on the outcome” - your impact matters

At Alpiq, your energy matters!

M ission

Ensure the operational security of Alpiq’s critical OT infrastructure by protecting industrial networks, control systems and communication flows. Define, maintain and continuously improve technical OT cybersecurity measures to reduce operational risks, strengthen asset resilience and help increase security maturity across Alpiq, its affiliated companies and its partners.

Position characteristics

Operational role in administering, monitoring and maintaining OT infrastructure, including direct responsibility for managing network security equipment.

• Expert role in cybersecurity for critical OT and industrial environments.

• Maintain and develop OT network architecture, segmentation, configurations and associated documentation.

• Contribute to projects, audits and improvement initiatives, acting as a technical expert for sites and partners.

• Participate in the on-call service to ensure the continuity and resilience of critical OT environments.

• Collaborate with OT, IT, cybersecurity and operations teams.
Your main responsibilities

• Security equipment management (firewalls, PAM, threat detection, SIEM, etc.) Administer, configure and maintain the equipment. Design filtering rules, analyse flows, approve communication openings and perform periodic reviews in accordance with segmentation and defence-in-depth principles.Analyse and address alerts generated by this equipment, as well as SOC alerts.

• IT for OT systems management Administer, configure and maintain Windows- and Linux-based systems and appliances.

• Network architecture and segmentation Contribute to defining and developing OT network security architectures, trust zones and interconnections with IT environments and partners.

• OT governance and cybersecurity Define, implement and maintain cybersecurity measures applicable to OT infrastructure. Contribute to standards, directives, risk assessments and remediation plans.

• Support for partner companies : Advise and support Alpiq’s partner companies in securing their OT environments.

• Security maturity Contribute to maturity assessments, audits and the monitoring of measures designed to sustainably strengthen the security level of industrial infrastructure.

• Expertise and incident response Provide expert support to projects and operations, participate in security incident analysis, and contribute to technical investigations and corrective actions.

• Documentation and continuous improvement Maintain documentation for architectures, configurations, filtering rules and procedures. Keep abreast of threats, technologies and industrial security frameworks.

• 24/7 on-call service Participate in the on-call service for IT for OT, Facility Management and OT security.
Your impact

• By strengthening the security, resilience and maturity of Alpiq’s OT environments, this position helps safeguard business continuity, support operational excellence and protect critical energy assets from evolving cyber threats.

Your profile

• Higher education in IT, networks, telecommunications, cybersecurity or an equivalent field.

• 5 years experience in OT cybersecurity and firewall administration.

• Knowledge of critical infrastructure and industrial or hydropower environments is an advantage.

• Experience in consulting, supporting partners or assessing security maturity.
Behavioral competencies

• Strong risk analysis skills and a strong sense of responsibility.

• Collaborative mindset.

• Ability to analyse risks and a strong sense of responsibility.

• Ability to advise, influence and support change.

• Communication tailored to technical and decision-making audiences.

• Autonomy, rigour and reliability in a critical environment.

• Collaborative mindset and ability to represent the organisation in industry forums.
Core requirements

• OT / ICS cybersecurity: Advanced

• Cybersecurity equipment administration: Expert

• Industrial network architecture and segmentation: Advanced

• OT cyber risk management: Advanced

• Incident investigation and response: Advanced

• OT security advisory and support: Advanced

• Communication: Advanced
Knowledge of cybersecurity standards

• SCADA environments and industrial control systems: Intermediate

• Windows Server and Linux administration: Advanced

• VMware virtualisation: Intermediate

• Technical French: Advanced

• Technical German: Intermediate

• Technical English: Advanced

ruolo operativo nell'amministrazione, monitoraggio e mantenimento dell'infrastruttura OT, compresa la responsabilità diretta per la gestione delle apparecchiature di sicurezza della rete.
